Laser-Sintered Constructs with Bio-inspired Porosity and Surface Micro/Nano-Roughness Enhance Mesenchymal Stem Cell Differentiation and Matrix Mineralization In Vitro.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Peripheral Background only in_vitro Exp. validation
Alice Cheng, David J Cohen, Barbara D Boyan, Zvi Schwartz Calcified tissue international 2016-12-01 10.1007/s00223-016-0184-9
单位: Department of Biomedical Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology and Emory University, 313 Ferst Drive NW, Atlanta, GA, 30313, USA.; Department of Biomedical Engineering, Peking University, Pekin
通讯: Barbara D Boyan @ Department of Biomedical Engineering, Georgia Institute of Technology and Emory University, 313 Ferst Drive NW, Atlanta,
相关性: 该论文涉及通过LPBF制备多孔钛合金植入物并评估其促成骨分化能力，但与应力遮挡或疲劳力学性能无直接关联。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, fatigue, or stiffness matching; no mechanical testing or implant-level biomechanics.
动机· 研究激光烧结多孔钛合金结构对干细胞成骨分化和骨整合的影响
方法· 通过直接金属激光烧结制备不同孔隙率的Ti-6Al-4V多孔支架，并表征表面微纳米粗糙度
结果· 三维多孔结构显著增强干细胞成骨分化和基质矿化，作用超过表面粗糙度
验证· 体外培养人骨髓间充质干细胞，检测成骨标志物和矿化沉积
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate whether bio-inspired porous architecture in laser-sintered Ti-6Al-4V constructs enhances osteogenic differentiation and matrix mineralization of human mesenchymal stem cells.
Method· Direct metal laser sintering was used to fabricate Ti-6Al-4V constructs with varying porosity (low, medium, high) based on trabecular bone template, followed by surface roughening to create micro/nano-scale topography.
Result· Three-dimensional porous constructs, especially medium porosity, promoted greater osteoblastic differentiation and sustained matrix mineralization over 8 weeks compared to two-dimensional surfaces.
Validation· In vitro culture of hMSCs with osteogenic media, BMP2 supplementation, or collagen coating, assessed by differentiation markers and mineralization assays.

LPBF Ti-6Al-4V porous construct osseointegration MSC differentiation in vitro

Fabrication and characterization of selective laser melting printed Ti–6Al–4V alloys subjected to heat treatment for customized implants design

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Skim only in_vitro Exp. validation
Mengke Wang, Yuwei Wu, Songhe Lu, Tong Chen, Yijiao Zhao et al. Progress in Natural Science Materials International 2016-12-01 10.1016/j.pnsc.2016.12.006
单位: 2nd Dental Center, School and Hospital of Stomatology, Peking University, Beijing 100081, China
通讯: Zhihui Tang @ 2nd Dental Center, School and Hospital of Stomatology, Peking University, Beijing 100081, China
相关性: 该论文涉及激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V合金的热处理与表面改性，但与应力遮挡、多孔结构或疲劳力学无关。
边界: No porous structures, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), and no stress shielding analysis.
动机· 通过热处理优化SLM Ti-6Al-4V表面性能以增强细胞相容性。
方法· 对SLM样品进行退火处理，表征表面形貌和相组成。
结果· 热处理形成亲水粗糙表面和TiO2层，促进hBMSC粘附和增殖。
验证· 体外细胞实验验证生物相容性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve the cytocompatibility of SLM Ti-6Al-4V implants by tailoring surface properties via heat treatment.
Method· As-printed Ti-6Al-4V substrates were subjected to heat treatment, and their surface wettability, roughness, and phase composition were characterized.
Result· Heat treatment produced a hydrophilic, rougher surface with a crystalline rutile TiO2 layer, significantly enhancing hBMSC adhesion and proliferation.
Validation· In vitro cell culture assays with human bone mesenchymal stem cells.

Hypervolume-based Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization with Student-t Processes

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling arxiv Transferable Save for project none UQ
Joachim van der Herten, Ivo Couckuyt, Tom Dhaene arXiv preprint 2016-12-01 link
相关性: 该论文提出了一种基于学生t过程的多目标贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移用于解决FEA代理模型中的昂贵采样效率问题，但未涉及约束处理和植入物生物力学设计。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or constraint handling in engineering design; it is a pure algorithmic study on synthetic benchmarks.
动机· 高斯过程在贝叶斯优化中存在局限性，学生t过程可提供更灵活的建模。
方法· 将学生t过程作为目标函数先验，推导了基于超体积的改进概率解析表达式。
结果· 在难优化的问题上优于传统高斯过程方法。
验证· 在合成多目标优化问题上进行数值验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Gaussian processes have limitations in Bayesian optimization; Student-t processes offer more flexible priors with predictive variance.
Method· An analytical hypervolume-based probability of improvement is derived for independent Student-t process priors of multiple objectives.
Result· The proposed approach outperforms traditional Gaussian process-based methods on a challenging multi-objective optimization problem.
Validation· Validation is performed on a synthetic multi-objective benchmark problem without experimental or engineering case studies.
Student-t process · 学生t过程Bayesian optimization · 贝叶斯优化hypervolume · 超体积multi-objective optimization · 多目标优化probability of improvement · 改进概率

Bayesian Optimization with a Finite Budget: An Approximate Dynamic Programming Approach

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Rémi Lam, Karen Willcox, David H. Wolpert Neural Information Processing Systems 2016-12-01 link
单位: Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, United States
通讯: Rémi Lam @ Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Cambridge, United States
相关性: 该论文提出了一种在有限预算下优化昂贵目标函数的贝叶斯优化方法，其动态规划近似策略可迁移至植入物设计中的多约束优化问题。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or biomechanics applications; it focuses on single-objective optimization with a finite budget.
动机· 在有限评估预算下优化昂贵目标函数，现有贝叶斯优化方法未充分利用预算信息。
方法· 将贝叶斯优化建模为动态规划问题，并采用rollout近似求解。
结果· 所提算法在有限预算下优于多种主流贝叶斯优化方法。
验证· 在多个标准优化基准函数上进行数值实验对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To optimize expensive black-box functions under a finite evaluation budget, where standard Bayesian optimization ignores the budget constraint.
Method· Formulate Bayesian optimization as a dynamic programming problem and approximate the optimal policy using rollout heuristics tailored to the setting.
Result· The proposed rollout-based algorithm outperforms several popular Bayesian optimization algorithms on benchmark functions with a finite budget.
Validation· Numerical experiments on standard optimization benchmarks comparing against existing Bayesian optimization methods.

通讯: Matthias Poloczek @ School of Operations Research and Information Engineering, Cornell University, Ithaca, NY, USA
相关性: 该论文提出了一种贝叶斯优化的热启动框架，可加速序列相关优化问题的求解，对用户在多目标约束下的植入物设计优化具有潜在迁移价值。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical implant design.
动机· 加速序列相关优化问题的求解，减少计算时间。
方法· 构建联合统计模型，利用信息价值计算推荐评估点。

Motivation· To reduce the solution time for a sequence of related optimization problems by warm-starting Bayesian optimization.
Method· A joint statistical model of all related objective functions is built, and a value-of-information calculation guides point selection.
Result· The proposed framework significantly reduces the number of evaluations needed to solve each problem in the sequence.
Validation· Numerical benchmarks on standard test functions demonstrate the efficiency gains.

Budgeted Batch Bayesian Optimization

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project numerical_benchmark
Vu Nguyen, Santu Rana, Sunil Gupta, Cheng Li, Svetha Venkatesh 2016-12-01 10.1109/icdm.2016.0144
单位: Deakin University, Australia
通讯: Vu Nguyen @ Deakin University, Australia
相关性: 该论文提出的预算批量贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真采样效率问题，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学背景。
边界: This paper focuses on batch Bayesian optimization for hyperparameter tuning and experimental design, but does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification beyond acquisition function peaks, or biomechanical implant design context.
动机· 固定批量贝叶斯优化浪费评估次数，需自适应确定批量大小。
方法· 使用无限高斯混合模型自动识别采集函数峰值数量，结合批量广义切片采样。
结果· 在基准函数和实际应用中，B3O以更少评估次数找到更优解。
验证· 通过基准函数和合金硬化实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Fixed-batch Bayesian optimization wastes evaluations when the batch size exceeds the number of acquisition function peaks, motivating adaptive batch sizing.
Method· The proposed B3O uses an infinite Gaussian mixture model to automatically identify the number of peaks in the acquisition function and employs batch generalized slice sampling for efficient sampling.
Result· B3O outperforms fixed-batch BO on benchmark functions and real-world applications (ML hyperparameter tuning and alloy hardening) with fewer evaluations.
Validation· Validation is performed on numerical benchmark functions and two real-world experimental design tasks.

边界: This paper focuses on fatigue safety factor optimization of hip implants using Taguchi method, but does not quantify proximal femur stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics.
动机· 减少定制髋关节假体疲劳测试的实验次数
方法· 基于147名患者CT数据，用Taguchi方法结合有限元分析优化假体几何参数

Motivation· To minimize the number of experiments required for fatigue testing of customized hip implants while identifying influential geometric parameters.
Method· Geometric parameters (HO, VO, NSA) were measured from CT scans of 147 patients, and finite element analysis combined with Taguchi method was used to compute fatigue safety factors.
Result· Horizontal offset had the greatest influence (54.38%) on fatigue safety factor, and experiment no. 8 yielded the highest safety factor.
Validation· Finite element results were validated by in vitro experimental tests.

Motivation· This systematic review assesses whether polyetheretherketone (PEEK) can serve as a viable alternative to titanium for dental implants based on bioactivity and osseointegration.

Motivation· To investigate the effects of different surface treatments on the fatigue behavior and osseointegration of dental implants.
Method· Four surface types (as-received, acid etching, spark-anodization, grit-blasted) were subjected to fatigue testing and in vivo evaluation in a rabbit model.
Result· Grit-blasting induced compressive residual stresses, improving fatigue life, and enhanced bone regeneration and mechanical retention at early implantation times.
Validation· Residual stresses were measured via X-ray diffraction; fatigue S-N curves were determined; osseointegration was assessed histometrically and by pull-out tests at 4 and 10 weeks.

Motivation· To evaluate whether thermal oxidation of Ti6Al4V dental implants and local growth hormone administration enhance osseointegration in osteoporotic conditions.

结果· 推荐内固定为主，假体置换限于特定情况
验证· 无验证，为观点性综述
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To discuss treatment options for distal femoral peri-prosthetic fractures above a well-fixed TKA.
Method· A clinical opinion review comparing internal fixation (retrograde nailing or lateral locked plating) versus mega prosthesis replacement.
Result· Internal fixation is preferred for most fractures due to high union rates, while prosthetic replacement is reserved for failed ORIF or severe osteolysis.
Validation· No experimental or numerical validation; the paper is a narrative review based on author experience.
